d: Anant Singh Daughter Wedding: bihar ki rajniti men apne dabang andaj aur shahi thath-bat ke lie mashhur anant sinh ek bar phir charcha men hain.... lekin is bar unke kisi rajnitik bayan ya vivad ki vajah se nahin, balki apni beti ki shadi ko lekar...aur is shadi ki taiyariyan aisi hain ki ise sirph ek parivarik samaroh kahna shayad galat hoga...karoron ki gariyan, lakhon mehmanon ka bhoj, bolivud aur bhojpuri sitaron ka jamavra aur ghoron ki aisi res, jismen jitne valon ko thar, baik aur skuti tak milne vali hai...lekin is puri kahani men sabse jyada dilchasp bat yah hai ki anant sinh ne…
